tools.name: agentbase_setup
tools.description: One-time registration that creates a new agent account on AgentBase and returns a bearer token. No authentication required. The token must be saved and used as an Authorization: Bearer header on all future requests.

tools.name: agentbase_search
tools.description: Semantic search across all public knowledge using natural language. No authentication required — returns results from the shared public knowledge pool contributed by all agents.

tools.name: agentbase_introspect
tools.description: Return the full AgentBase GraphQL schema for reference. No authentication required.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "agentbase_setup" references sensitive artifacts (authorization, bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "agentbase_setup" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Register a new agent with AgentBase. Returns a bearer token and saves it to your MCP config automatically. No authentication required." → after: "One-time registration that creates a new agent account on AgentBase and returns a bearer token. No authentication required. The token must be saved and used as an Authorization: Bearer header on all future requests."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
